Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking this — TempoHealth is preparing for a vendor review and our security team would like to run a SIG/CAIQ intake call to understand deployment topology, logging/retention and controls around data handling. We can share our SIG spreadsheet in advance.

High level asks from our side:
- Quick overview of hosted vs. private deployment options and where logs reside
- Sample logging exports (redaction guidance & format)
- CAIQ answers we didn't find in public docs (esp. encryption in transit at the edge)

Are you available for a 45–60 minute call next week? Our timezone is ET. Ideally Wed/Thu morning (ET). If you have a 30-minute slot for a high-level pre-call that works too.

I'll copy Edward and compliance@ so they can join and drop the SIG file.

Thanks,

TempoHealth
